title: Changes to the Hawaiian Cultural Restoration Revolving Fund
summary: On April 13, 2026, the committee discussed Bill 63, which would rename the Hawaiian Cultural Restoration Revolving Fund and widen where its money can be used. It will be voted on when the committee votes on all the bills, and the title needs a small fix to put Lahaina before Royal. The fund holds $1.1 million, and the department will confirm in writing that nothing is funded twice and whether canoes can be paid from it.
